topic: Funnel chart implementation and library selection
summary_markdown:
The discussion centered on implementing a funnel chart. [p2] suggested using Highcharts due to its superior Sankey diagram capabilities, though this was noted as optional.

[me] expressed a preference for keeping the implementation within Chart.js and avoiding the addition of large external libraries or switching frameworks entirely. [p2] clarified that the goal was not necessarily to switch libraries but to utilize specific components or charts that Chart.js currently lacks.

[p1] provided information regarding a potential component size (143kb unpacked) and noted the limited availability of funnel chart options in current applications.
decisions: Maintain use of Chart.js framework where possible to implement the funnel chart.
